description.value:
Effect Hit bonus +2. Hits against tracked Burn, Shock, Bleed, or Wind Shear grant one Prophet stack per distinct type, maximum 4 per combat. Each stack grants attack bonus +1. At 4, your DoTs gain one die step, recalculated each tick; cap d12.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching nihility Path required.

source.custom: Honkai: Star Rail / Telys D&D conversion
